text:
Symptom: black-screen boot after img.bin change.
Cause: full img.bin rewrite (Image.write / --full-repack) rebuilds package layout incorrectly for playable boots.
Do: same-offset package splice only into live MOD img.bin.
Don't: Image.write full rewrite or --full-repack as a deploy path.
Pointer: technical.md#§0 | rule:img-exact-zlib-deploy | rule:patch-safety

Symptom: crash or blank all text after a clock/MakeStr patch.
Cause: global MakeStr hook (removed patch_clock_text.py) breaks every string path.
Do: leave MakeStr alone; use package/TRB/DrawText paths that are already verified.
Don't: revive patch_clock_text.py or any global MakeStr hook.
Pointer: technical.md#§0 | rule:patch-safety

Symptom: LayeredFS EN packages disappear / later packages wiped after splice.
Cause: splice_packages_into_img(bak, …, live MOD) when bak ≠ MOD copies entire bak over MOD.
Do: extract vanilla packages from bak; splice those bytes into the live MOD img.bin.
Don't: pass bak as both source image and live MOD target.
Pointer: technical.md#§0 | rule:img-exact-zlib-deploy

Symptom: Options freeze / CESA-class crash after zlib splice.
Cause: short zlib stream, trailing NUL pad, or shrunk cmp_len so unused_data != 0.
Do: compressed stream length must equal the slot; pad plaintext (spaces) before compress; verify unused_data == 0.
Don't: NUL-pad compressed tails or shrink cmp_len to "fit".
Pointer: technical.md#§11 | rule:img-exact-zlib-deploy

Symptom: heap smash / white boot after growing PACK or pkg 90.
Cause: grow PACK or grow pkg 90 dec_len without updating idx-table size.
Do: update idx-table sizes whenever dec_len / PACK payload grows.
Don't: grow payload and leave stale idx sizes.
Pointer: technical.md#§12 | rule:patch-safety

Symptom: works in Azahar, prefetch-abort on hardware.
Cause: code caves placed in .rodata (e.g. 0x006E6A38, 0x006FBB08).
Do: caves only in .text (0x0068F800 / 0x0068F900).
Don't: put executable caves in .rodata.
Pointer: technical.md#§15.1 | rule:patch-safety

Symptom: dead taps on name keyboard after patch.
Cause: candmode_reset writing +0x24=0 — bisect-proven ban.
Do: keep candidate-mode state machine intact; use shipped nullguards + romaji DrawCell + kana-direct NOP stack.
Don't: candmode_reset (+0x24=0) or revive candidate-list caves @ 0x006FC000.
Pointer: technical.md#§15.2 | rule:patch-safety

Symptom: "playable" only via Azahar LayeredFS; no gold bake/CIA.
Cause: treating Azahar-only LayeredFS as the ship path — incomplete.
Do: every playable patch needs gold bake/CIA and a LayeredFS deploy path in the same change.
Don't: ship or call done with Azahar LayeredFS alone.
Pointer: technical.md#§17.2 | rule:bakable-and-layeredfs | rule:from-scratch-bake

Symptom: hardware LayeredFS → bottom screen white; CIA boots.
Cause: hardware LayeredFS path unresolved; iterating it as release wastes cycles.
Do: ship CIA (gold bake). Use Azahar LayeredFS for fast a/b only.
Don't: keep iterating hardware LayeredFS as the release path.
Pointer: docs/layeredfs-investigation.md | technical.md#§17.2

Symptom: gold assets / EngPatch WIP vanished after stash.
Cause: git stash for WIP EngPatch work; orphaned stash lost bake assets.
Do: commit WIP on a branch instead of stashing.
Don't: git stash for EngPatch / gold bake WIP.
Pointer: technical.md#§0 | rule:from-scratch-bake

Symptom: screen still JP even though TRB is already EN.
Cause: chrome is often baked into textures / DrawText paths, not TRB strings.
Do: GPU-dump first; classify alpha text vs baked control vs DrawText before editing TRB.
Don't: burn time on TRB-only when TRB entries are already EN.
Pointer: technical.md#§12.1 | rule:ui-localization-method

Symptom: opaque softkeys / labels still JP (Back/Next/OK/Quit).
Cause: glyphs live in shared ETC1A4 BCLIM chrome, not TRB.
Do: BCLIM splice in pkg 5238; same-size replace when dimensions match.
Don't: hunt OptionClock/SysPopup TRB for softkeys.
Pointer: technical.md#§12.2 | rule:ui-localization-method | pkg:5238

Symptom: alpha "text" survives DrawText nuclear remap and still shows JP.
Cause: A8 atlas glyphs (often Com_M_Sel_*) are BCLIM, not DrawText strings.
Do: identify via MAD/image_map; replace BCLIM (same-size or arc repack).
Don't: keep remapping DrawText when alpha tiles persist.
Pointer: technical.md#§12.3 | rule:ui-localization-method

Symptom: titles are EN but clipped on pane.
Cause: pane font metrics are global; long EN overflows.
Do: shorten EN string (e.g. To-Do STRI 2837), not grow the pane font.
Don't: assume TRB EN alone fixes layout clip.
Pointer: technical.md#§12.4

Symptom: translations.json key never matches (e.g. Anywhere Date STRI 25183 …デートを作).
Cause: truncated JP codebook key ≠ full STRI key.
Do: keep the full JP codebook key when looking up / writing translations.json.
Don't: truncate keys to "fit" tooling UIs.
Pointer: technical.md#§12.5

Symptom: fried MultiWin 192×16 bar after texture work.
Cause: LANCZOS-fill / overlong bar copy onto a tiny plate.
Do: shorten bar copy (e.g. Heart to Heart, not "Girlfriend Communication"); preserve plate geometry.
Don't: LANCZOS-fill a plate onto the 192×16 MultiWin bar.
Pointer: technical.md#§12 | rule:ui-localization-method

Symptom: colorful hub header noise after Zhoumaru dump.
Cause: bad Zhoumaru RGB dump of Title_menu_word @ pkg 5261.
Do: re-render gray; split RGB vs alpha before packing dumps.
Don't: pack noisy RGB dumps straight into Title hub chrome.
Pointer: technical.md#§12 | rule:zhoumaru-ui-pack | pkg:5261

Symptom: need Back/Next/OK/Quit/Restore Default softkey chrome.
Cause: shared softkey textures live in package 5238 (ETC1A4), not OptionClock/SysPopup.
Do: edit pkg 5238; last-writer order matters (Defaults → card side btn).
Don't: search contiguous strings / wrong packages for softkeys.
Pointer: technical.md#§12 | rule:ui-localization-method | pkg:5238

Symptom: hub Options + clock title still JP.
Cause: A8 chrome in package 5245 — not MyroomHeader optn_tex_*.
Do: BCLIM/A8 work in 5245 for hub Options + clock title.
Don't: confuse with in-room Options (5380+5575) or Defaults softkey (5238).
Pointer: technical.md#§12 | pkg:5245

Symptom: password window chrome wrong / still JP.
Cause: Pass_Win01 lives in package 5251.
Do: target 5251 for password window textures.
Don't: rewrite STRI 24550 なし globally for password holes — append unique STRI + retarget INDX.
Pointer: technical.md#§12 | docs/password-codes.md | pkg:5251

Symptom: Display/Sound panels still JP.
Cause: panels in package 5247 — not the Defaults softkey package.
Do: edit 5247 for Display/Sound panel chrome.
Don't: use 5238 Defaults softkey path for these panels.
Pointer: technical.md#§12 | pkg:5247

Symptom: Main Menu hub rows still JP.
Cause: Title hub chrome in package 5261 — not NCommonMSel Text02–05.
Do: Title.arc / 5261 path; EngPatch last-writer on shared pkgs.
Don't: treat NCommonMSel Text02–05 as the hub row source.
Pointer: technical.md#§12 | rule:zhoumaru-ui-pack | pkg:5261

Symptom: in-room Options overlay still JP while hub Options fixed.
Cause: in-room overlay is packages 5380 + 5575 — distinct from hub Options 5245.
Do: patch 5380/5575 for in-room overlay.
Don't: assume hub Options 5245 covers in-room UI.
Pointer: technical.md#§12 | pkg:5380 | pkg:5575

Symptom: resident/day names wrong at runtime though RomFS resident TRB edited.
Cause: runtime resident strings come from package 5508; RomFS resident TRB unused for that path.
Do: edit 5508 for runtime resident/day names.
Don't: only patch RomFS resident TRB and expect runtime change.
Pointer: technical.md#§12 | pkg:5508

Symptom: boot CESA / warning screen still JP or wrong art.
Cause: boot CESA is pkg 90 TEX — not Zhoumaru / not IMAGE_MAP hub chrome.
Do: EngPatcher/CESA render path for pkg 90 TEX.
Don't: treat Zhoumaru UI pack dumps as CESA.
Pointer: technical.md#§12 | rule:zhoumaru-ui-pack | pkg:90

Symptom: wasted time hunting softkeys / ３ＤＳ本体時計.
Cause: wrong paths — OptionClock/SysPopup for softkeys; contiguous string hunt for clock title; TRB-only for confirm/Options chrome.
Do: softkeys→5238; hub Options/clock→5245 A8; GPU-dump for chrome.
Don't: OptionClock/SysPopup softkey hunts or TRB-only for confirm chrome.
Pointer: technical.md#§12 | rule:ui-localization-method

Symptom: bake takes ~16h or fails size/match after "optimize with zopfli first".
Cause: wrong compression order; per-byte fine loops on large ARCs.
Do: empty-block zlib → gap-salt → zero inter-file pads → zopfli. Use --pkg-workers (cold pack ~40min–2h).
Don't: start with zopfli; no per-byte fine loops on large ARCs.
Pointer: technical.md#§17.2 | rule:from-scratch-bake

Symptom: JP glyphs stain through EN A8 plates.
Cause: canvas not full-cleared before drawing EN.
Do: full-clear A8 canvas before EN glyphs.
Don't: overdraw EN on uncleared JP alpha.
Pointer: technical.md#§12 | rule:ui-localization-method

Symptom: clean clone has EN dialog + JP menus; bake never injected.
Cause: gold bake artifacts are gitignored — clone without bake hook looks half-localized.
Do: run from-scratch bake / inject gold bake; ensure bake hook + LayeredFS deploy in same change.
Don't: assume git clone alone ships a playable EN UI bake.
Pointer: technical.md#§17.2 | rule:from-scratch-bake | rule:bakable-and-layeredfs

Symptom: Drop CIA reuse of slim RomFS / pack cache corrupts rebuild.
Cause: Drop CIA wipes out/, release/, cache/; NLPP_USE_PACK_CACHE across from-scratch is unsafe.
Do: treat Drop as clean; rebuild without reusing slim RomFS or pack cache across from-scratch.
Don't: NLPP_USE_PACK_CACHE across a from-scratch Drop bake.
Pointer: technical.md#§17.2 | rule:from-scratch-bake

Symptom: bake writes ~2× (680 MB mirror) unexpectedly.
Cause: NLPP_ALSO_AZAHAR left on without --also-azahar intent.
Do: bake rebuild must set NLPP_ALSO_AZAHAR=0 unless explicitly --also-azahar.
Don't: leave ALSO_AZAHAR on for every cold pack.
Pointer: technical.md#§17.2 | rule:from-scratch-bake

Symptom: Defaults softkey or Title hub regresses after another EngPatch step.
Cause: last-writer order on shared pkgs (5238, 5261, …).
Do: sequence writers deliberately (e.g. 5238 Defaults → card side btn; 5261 title EngPatch last).
Don't: assume independent package edits commute.
Pointer: technical.md#§17.2 | pkg:5238 | pkg:5261

Symptom: file xrefs empty; runtime pointers not found in Ghidra.
Cause: Ghidra base 0; runtime VA = file + 0x100000.
Do: search LE runtime pointers (file_offset + 0x100000) when file xrefs empty. Title ID 00040000000F4E00.
Don't: assume Ghidra file offsets equal runtime VAs.
Pointer: technical.md#§1 | technical.md#§15

Symptom: Ghidra search misses UTF-8 Japanese strings present in binaries.
Cause: Ghidra string analyzers often miss UTF-8 JP.
Do: search with Python over binaries for UTF-8 JP / softkey Pos names.
Don't: conclude a string is absent because Ghidra Listing search failed.
Pointer: technical.md#§5 | technical.md#§15

Symptom: wrong UI family after editing Pos_Com_Btn_m vs Pos_com_btn_m.
Cause: softkey Pos names are duplicated with different casing — different UI families.
Do: match exact Pos_* spelling for the target UI family.
Don't: treat Pos_Com_Btn_m and Pos_com_btn_m as aliases.
Pointer: technical.md#§15

Symptom: name keyboard / candidate list patches crash or dead-tap.
Cause: candidate-list caves and candmode_reset are banned; ship stack is narrower.
Do: ship nullguards + romaji DrawCell + kana-direct NOP; scrap caves @ 0x006FC000.
Don't: revive candidate-list caves or candmode_reset.
Pointer: technical.md#§15.1–15.2 | rule:patch-safety

Symptom: Message Speed slider ignored on voiced lines.
Cause: TalkWindow tick path not tied to Options table.
Do: Options FUN_005d1e18 values 14/8/2/0; TalkWindow table ÷4 + tick cap so voiced lines honor slider.
Don't: only patch UI label without table/tick coupling.
Pointer: technical.md#§15.5

Symptom: Title hub NX abort on open.
Cause: null pane in FindPaneByName — not CESA/extra-data.
Do: patch_lyt_null_pane.py for null pane.
Don't: chase CESA/extra-data for this abort class.
Pointer: technical.md#§15.6

Symptom: Communications spinner hang in Azahar.
Cause: Azahar OpenLinkFile clone of full extdata — not pkg 5237.
Do: fix in ../azahar-3ds-accurate fork; export patches; never push fork / never PR upstream Azahar.
Don't: blame pkg 5237 or tell user to quit between a/b unless LayeredFS reload is proven stuck.
Pointer: CLAUDE.md | rule:azahar-3ds-accurate | ab_test/README.md

Symptom: intermittent Game Start hang; reset continues.
Cause: parent archive OpenLinkFile (~1.62 GiB) in emulator — not hardware.
Do: treat as Azahar archive clone cost; reset/continue; fix upstream in azahar-3ds-accurate if chasing.
Don't: attribute to NLPP package corruption on hardware without CIA repro.
Pointer: CLAUDE.md | rule:azahar-3ds-accurate

Symptom: a/b testing friction / told to quit emulator every run.
Cause: Azahar a/b instances under ab_test/ support parallel paths.
Do: use ab_test/ instances; only force quit if LayeredFS reload is proven stuck.
Don't: default to "quit Azahar between every test".
Pointer: ab_test/README.md

Symptom: profile name panes westernized (First above Last).
Cause: JP profile rows stay 姓 then 名 (Last above First).
Do: keep 姓/名 pane order; localize strings only.
Don't: westernize pane order.
Pointer: technical.md#§16.7

Symptom: yellow labels look crushed / 1-bit after EN render.
Cause: RGB565 yellow labels need chroma ramps (2× Heisei), not 1-bit crush.
Do: use chroma ramps when rendering yellow RGB565 labels.
Don't: 1-bit crush yellow label plates.
Pointer: technical.md#§16.8

Symptom: NULs appear inside longer heroine surname strings.
Cause: replace_all on short keys plants NULs; slots are exact C-string lengths.
Do: exact C-string slot replaces only; Rinko family slot is Kobayaka (length fit), not full Kobayakawa.
Don't: replace_all short surname keys across the binary.
Pointer: technical.md#§16.7

Symptom: password hole / なし string breaks unrelated UI after global rewrite.
Cause: rewriting STRI 24550 なし globally.
Do: append unique STRI + retarget INDX for password holes.
Don't: global rewrite of STRI 24550.
Pointer: docs/password-codes.md | technical.md#§12

Symptom: "TRB ~98%" or PNG counts treated as done.
Cause: TRB% ≠ playable done; PNG counts = masters present, not % of vanilla BCLIMs.
Do: playable = bake hook + LayeredFS deploy + CIA gold path; measure by screens fixed.
Don't: declare done from TRB% or master PNG counts alone.
Pointer: technical.md#§21–23

Symptom: agent string-hunts before reading settled docs; rediscovers dead ends.
Cause: skipping technical.md + rules; not documenting wins/dead ends.
Do: read docs/technical.md + .cursor/rules before hunts; prefer Zhoumaru .check PNGs; bisect patches one-at-a-time on vanilla; write wins/dead ends back to technical.md + matching rule; playable = bake + LayeredFS in same change.
Don't: CESA/Zhoumaru mixups; multi-patch bisect on dirty trees.
Pointer: technical.md#§0 | .cursor/rules/*

Symptom: how to patch EN text into NLPP img.bin without breaking zlib layout.
Cause: STRI/text blobs use fixed cmp_len zlib slots.
Do: decompress → measure → compress ≤ cmp_len → space-pad plaintext if short → write same offset → verify unused_data==0 + round-trip.
Don't: grow compressed size without rebuild; NUL-pad compressed tail; full img rewrite.
Pointer: technical.md#§11 | rule:img-exact-zlib-deploy

Symptom: when to replace BCLIM in-place vs repack Title.arc.
Cause: same-size slot vs larger texture/mips/format.
Do: same-size → in-place; larger → Title.arc absolute-align grow (pkg 5261 pattern) + update refs.
Don't: blind overwrite when new BCLIM size ≠ old entry size.
Pointer: technical.md#§12 | rule:zhoumaru-ui-pack | pkg:5261

Symptom: menus still JP after Drop / LayeredFS-only "ship".
Cause: gold bake never injected, or Azahar LayeredFS treated as release; hardware LayeredFS white-screens.
Do: Drop CIA gold bake first, then Azahar LayeredFS for iterate; ship CIA.
Don't: hardware LayeredFS as release; Azahar-only as done.
Pointer: technical.md#§17.2 | docs/layeredfs-investigation.md | rule:bakable-and-layeredfs
